owner: Immediate activity ambient language exposure span
source_discovery_scope: Immediate schedule evaluation and actual language exposure
disposition: Immediate activity intentionally represents its selected actual duration as a daily allocation and calls apply_training with MINUTES_PER_DAY as the schedule evaluation span. The same elapsed argument independently computes two-thirds of elapsed settlement hours for ambient oral language learning. A one-hour surviving settlement activity therefore supplies 16 ambient hours rather than two-thirds of one hour, conditional on positive settlement language coefficient and aptitude/cap allowing gain. Normal settlement rest, camp and stationary callers pass their actual training or downtime span. No live character result has been executed.
alias_result: Keep broader training and language allocation contracts independently tracked.
remaining_after_discovery: After audit gate, distinguish schedule evaluation span from actual ambient exposure span using existing time and schedule owners, preserve selected activity training and clipped clock behavior, and test short, full-day, clipped, zero-coefficient and capped-language cases. Reconcile other training and settlement-language contracts independently.
